def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, json
def build(I,O,name):
    I=np.array(I); O=np.array(O)
    pts=np.argwhere(I==2)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=pts[:,0].min(),pts[:,0].max(),pts[:,1].min(),pts[:,1].max()
    H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    seeds=list(zip(*np.argwhere((I!=2)&(I!=0))))
    # tile = unique pattern? Use most common value per residue class, excluding cells where output equals rect color 2 (original)? no—just take mode of O at each residue among non-seed cells
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=[[Counter() for _ in range(W)] for _ in range(H)]
    for rr in range(I.shape[0]):
        for cc in range(I.shape[1]):
            if (rr,cc) in set(seeds): continue
            cnt[rr%H][cc%W][int(O[rr,cc])]+=1

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    pts=np.argwhere(I==2)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=pts[:,0].min(),pts[:,0].max(),pts[:,1].min(),pts[:,1].max()
    seeds=[(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(np.argwhere((I!=2)&(I!=0))[:,0], np.argwhere((I!=2)&(I!=0))[:,1])]
    outs=set(map(tuple,zip(*np.argwhere(O==2))))
    inr=set(map(tuple,pts)); others=outs-inr
    print('===',name,'rect',(r0,c0),'dims',(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1))
    print('  extra 2s:',len(others))
    for p in sorted(others)[:60]:
        ds=[abs(p[0]-s[0])+abs(p[1]-s[1]) for s in seeds]
        idx=min(range(len(seeds)),key=lambda k:ds[k])
        print('    ',p,'d=',ds[idx],'seed=',seeds[idx])

import numpy as np, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(inp):
    I=np.array(inp)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells); c0=min(c for _,c in cells)
    h=max(r for r,_ in cells)-r0+1; w=max(c for _,c in cells)-c0+1
    out=np.zeros_like(I)
    # paint rectangle copies centered at each seed
    for r,c,v in [(rr,cc,int(I[rr][cc])) for rr in range(I.shape[0]) for cc in range(I.shape[1]) if I[rr][cc]!=2]:
        tr=r-h//2; tc=c-w//2
        out[max(0,tr):min(out.shape[0],tr+h),max(0,tc):min(out.shape[1],tc+w)] = 2
    out[r0:r0+h,c0:c0+w]=2  # keep original rect
    out[I!=2]=I[I!=2]       # restore seeds (they were 0 originally; set properly)
    return out.tolist()

    Ii=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); Oi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    o=f(Ii.tolist())
    print(n, np.array_equal(np.array(o),Oi))
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

for n in [1,2,3]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=I.shape
    # true solid rect from all-2 cells
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=2 and I[r][c]!=0]
    print('=== demo',n,'rect',bh,bw)
    for s in seeds:
        # score = number of non-2 block cells conflicting with O
        scores=[]
        for dr in range(-H,H):
            for dc in range(-W,W):
                cnt=sum(1 for i in range(bh) for j in range(bw)
                        if 0<=dr+i<H and 0<=dc+j<W and (dr+i,dc+j)!=s and O[dr+i][dc+j]!=2)
                scores.append(cnt)
        mins=min(scores)
        cands=[(dr,dc,scores[0]) for dr,dc,s in zip([sc for sc in scores],[None]*len(scores),scores) if sc==mins][:8]
        print('   seed',s,'min-conflicts',mins,'placements:',[(list(zip(*map(str,tuple(range(dr+1)))),))]) if False else ''
        print('   seed',s,'best:',sorted(cands)[:6])

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

# demo1: P = solid 8x8 block, rows 1-8, cols 2-9; seeds = 8s.
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
P=np.ones((8,8))
H,W=I.shape
seeds=[(r,c,int(I[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==8]
print('seeds:',seeds)
for dr,dc,v in seeds:
    cnts=[]
    for tr in range(-H,H):
        for tc in range(-W,W):
            # require placement fully inside? skip
            if tr+8>H or tc+8>W: continue
            cc=sum(1 for i in range(8) for j in range(8)
                   if 0<=tr+i<H and 0<=tc+j<W and (tr+i,tc+j)!=(dr,dc) and O[tr+i][tc+j]!=2)
            cnts.append(cc)
    print(' seed',(dr,dc),'color',v,'min conflicts:',min(cnts), 'placements with min:',[(t_) for t_,c in zip([(tr,tc) for tr in range(-H,H) for tc in range(-W,W) if tr+8<=H and tc+8<=W],cnts) if c==min(cnts)][:12])

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in [1,2,3]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    extra=[(i,j) for i in range(O.shape[0]) for j in range(O.shape[1]) if O[i,j]==2 and I[i,j]==0]
    removed=[(i,j) for i in range(O.shape[0]) for j in range(O.shape[1]) if I[i,j]==2 and O[i,j]==0]
    print('demo',n,'extra:',len(extra),'removed:',len(removed))
    print('  extra coords:',sorted(extra)[:20],'...' if len(extra)>20 else '')
    print('  removed:',sorted(removed)[:10])
